scope: controller-only; do not copy into agent knowledge seeds

01.gate: fixed headroom; worst applicable window; explicit forecast
01.selection: first eligible task-specific model in stable priority list
01.hypothesis: Conservative predictable operation with low routing overhead.

02.gate: fixed reserve plus proportional remaining-window envelope with 10% burst allowance
02.selection: minimize predicted normalized quota consumption across both windows; stable task preference breaks ties
02.hypothesis: Time-aware pacing prevents premature exhaustion and improves sustained yield.

03.gate: fixed reserve plus bounded attempts and escalation only on verified failure
03.selection: start with first eligible task-appropriate model; escalate one level after failed independent oracle; no downgrade on failed gate
03.hypothesis: Cheap-first solving with verified escalation reduces consumption without reducing accepted quality.

04.gate: fixed reserve plus conservative forecast; bounded exploration; unmeasured costs never free
04.selection: maximize lower confidence bound of verified utility per worst-window predicted quota cost; deterministic bounded exploration of eligible alternatives
04.hypothesis: Learn task-specific comparative efficiency over repeated workloads.

common: Explicit authorized native OpenAI GPT on Codex and Gemini on Antigravity; subscription only, no paid overflow
All applicable windows and fresh quota, global account reservation and owner-defined local ceilings
Deterministic native bypass for already solved work
Identical verification oracle, workload and telemetry; no policy may weaken common floor
Models share a quota group; do not treat models/lanes as separate pools

evaluation.phase1: Offline same trace and identical task inputs, each simulated account starts from identical quota. Synthetic or historical traces cannot establish actual model quality.
evaluation.phase2: Two independent subscription pools, one active lane per provider; reserve the other half of each daily pool. Later rotate seed, policy and provider assignments for causal comparison.
metrics: verified task value per observed quota percentage point, separately per window
accepted tasks and failed tasks, latency, retries, tokens, native reuse
time blocked, quota reserve violations, unused quota at reset
switching and context reconstruction overhead, exploration cost
evaluation.accounting: Provider percentages may be rounded; zero observed delta is censored, not free. Attribute consumption only where no overlapping external usage and same window identity; otherwise mark ambiguous. Compare effective verified work, not model-reported completion.
